description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named NinePatchLab, which provides a UI for testing and demonstrating the use of nine-patch drawable resources, with features to toggle dithering and filtering, switch backgrounds, and display FPS metrics.

classes.name: NinePatchLab
classes.description: Main activity for displaying and interacting with nine-patch drawables, managing background and button resources, and updating display parameters.

classes.name: NPView
classes.description: Custom View class that handles drawing of backgrounds and buttons, and manages user interaction for toggling settings and backgrounds, as well as FPS measurement.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the activity's title bar with current settings and FPS information.

methods.name: make_custom_bg
methods.description: Creates a gradient drawable with custom colors to be used as a background.

methods.name: make_solid_bg
methods.description: Creates a solid color drawable to be used as a background.

methods.name: toggleFPS
methods.description: Toggles the display of FPS counter and related metrics.
